source: Private root-conversation export; not distributed. Verify the recorded complete-byte prefix and event line references against the owner-held export.
method: Pair root task_started with task_complete or turn_aborted by turn_id. Sum recorded duration_ms only for ended pairs. Check overlap independently using event timestamps. No child-agent session durations are added.

direct_wait_tool_intervals.meaning: Elapsed direct wait/sleep calls within root turns; already included in turn totals. This is not an exhaustive waiting-time measure and must not be added to or subtracted from the total to infer human labor.

category_method: Conservative keyword tags from user messages only. Mixed categories do not split a turn. Tags overlap and tag totals must not be added. Categories describe request topics, not measured activity allocation; human review is required for semantic task accounting.
limitations: One root conversation, not all user conversations or total project labor.
Turn elapsed time includes model generation, tools, tests, explicit waits and waiting for child agents.
No human labor, tracker-approved time, CPU time, or exclusive focused effort can be inferred.
Incomplete current report turn is excluded; no end duration is invented.
Gaps between root turns are excluded; other work during gaps is unknown.
duration_ms and event timestamp intervals differ slightly because their timing boundaries differ; both are retained, with no false millisecond precision about human work.
Topic tags and categories are heuristic, not a validated per-feature timesheet.

independent_reconciliation.method: Independent second streaming parse of the exact hashed complete-byte prefix; paired unique turn IDs; regrouped durations by source start-event CST date. Asserted equality with primary totals and daily table.

open_turn_observed.meaning: Observed event-timestamp elapsed of currently open root turn only; no recorded end duration exists. Not human labor or an authoritative completed-turn duration.
